description: NEGATIVE CONTROL for audio_cues_corpus_negative (PL.native-step-clock-row), made from core's conformance/audio/cues.json at 45409ed: the contract's footsteps.gaits.run.intervalSec set to 0.3, seven footstep cases given the answer a wrong step clock would give (each named 'expected WRONGLY': Godot's template dropping the remainder at a step, a long frame not folded, standing keeping the clock, a negative frame moving it, the right foot first, an unknown surface marked table, idle stepping), and one case of an op that is neither a footstep op nor one the runner lists as unreached. Every other case is core's, unchanged: the footstep ones must still pass and the ambient and music ones stay not reached. The runner must report each and fail the run.
sources: core conformance/audio/cues.json at 45409ed (P5.core 565b6b4), changed as the description says

keys.music: none: atelier has no music key family; a music state plays the key a world or pack binds to it, or silence

ambient.volume: Math.round((clamp01(level) * band * place * weather) / 1000) / 1000, the three gains whole percentages from the voice's row; a missing weather column, or no sky, is 100
ambient.dropped: a cue whose volume is 0 is not in the set
ambient.muffled: true exactly when the place is indoor
ambient.ids: <key>#<n>, n counting the statements of that key in canonical order (key; everywhere before positioned; then x, z, y, radius; louder first)
ambient.statements: unusable ones dropped (a key outside terrain.ambience.<voice>, a level that is not a number); a key stated twice everywhere is kept once, at its loudest; a position without a positive radius is everywhere

footsteps.match: exact, then by ancestor (drop the last dot segment); no row at all is the default surface, source default; a null row is no step
footsteps.clock: not stepping (no stepping gait, or a silent surface) resets to 0 and the left foot; otherwise add dtSec (non-finite or <= 0 adds nothing); at >= interval one step falls, the interval is subtracted, and a remainder still >= interval is folded with %; feet alternate

music.precedence: combat, then tension (alert), then the place: indoor is interior; settlement and wilderness (explore) each have a _night state in the clock's night band
music.duck: Math.round(volume * duckPercent / 100 * 1000) / 1000 while an NPC speaks
music.transition: nothing playing yet: fade_in; same state and key: none, or volume when only the volume moved; otherwise crossfade, intoCombat into combat, outOfCombat out of it, tension into or out of tension, else crossfade
music.binding: the binding for this settlement, then the one with no settlement; two for one state take the smallest key; a binding with no state or an empty key is ignored
music.stingerBinding: state stinger.<id>, by the same rule
